\section[(dialogue)]{Things you carry, school and food — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R121-first-pass-things-you-carry-school-and-food}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a jacket and pyjamas.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a wallet, an umbrella, a bag, a basket, a candle
  \item matches, a toy, a ball, a kite, a bed frame
  \item a drawer, a letter, a letter, a pencil, an exercise book
  \item an exam, a language; the tongue, a vegetable, an onion, garlic
  \item ginger, a cauliflower, peas, a cucumber, a watermelon
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A wallet? (\textbf{\ur{بٹوا}}, \emph{baṭuā}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{\ur{چھتری}}, \emph{chhatrī}.) A bag? (\textbf{\ur{تھیلا}}, \emph{thailā}.) A basket? (\textbf{\ur{ٹوکری}}, \emph{ṭokrī}.) A candle? (\textbf{\ur{موم} \ur{بتی}}, \emph{mombattī}.) Matches? (\textbf{\ur{ماچس}}, \emph{māchis}.) A toy? (\textbf{\ur{کھلونا}}, \emph{khilaunā}.) A ball? (\textbf{\ur{گیند}}, \emph{gēnd}.) A kite? (\textbf{\ur{پتنگ}}, \emph{patang}.) A bed frame? (\textbf{\ur{پلنگ}}, \emph{palang}.) A drawer? (\textbf{\ur{دراز}}, \emph{darāz}.) A letter? (\textbf{\ur{چٹھی}}, \emph{chiṭṭhī}.) A letter? (\textbf{\ur{خط}}, \emph{khat}.) A pencil? (\textbf{\ur{پنسل}}, \emph{pensil}.) An exercise book? (\textbf{\ur{کاپی}}, \emph{kāpī}.) An exam? (\textbf{\ur{امتحان}}, \emph{imtihān}.) A language; the tongue? (\textbf{\ur{زبان}}, \emph{zabān}.) A vegetable? (\textbf{\ur{سبزی}}, \emph{sabzī}.) An onion? (\textbf{\ur{پیاز}}, \emph{piyāz}.) Garlic? (\textbf{\ur{لہسن}}, \emph{lahsan}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\ur{ادرک}}, \emph{adrak}.) A cauliflower? (\textbf{\ur{گوبھی}}, \emph{gobhī}.) Peas? (\textbf{\ur{مٹر}}, \emph{maṭar}.) A cucumber? (\textbf{\ur{کھیرا}}, \emph{khīrā}.) A watermelon?
